import numpy as np

# Assuming spectra[0] is the one just measured since it's the only one this session usually
spec = spectra[-1] 
x = spec['raman_shift']
y = spec['intensity']

# Simple peak detection for D and G bands (roughly)
d_band_idx = np.argmax(y[ (x > 1300) & (x < 1400) ]) + np.where(x > 1300)[0][0]
g_band_idx = np.argmax(y[ (x > 1550) & (x < 1650) ]) + np.where(x > 1550)[0][0]

print(f"D-band: {x[d_band_idx]:.2f} cm-1, intensity {y[d_band_idx]:.2f}")
print(f"G-band: {x[g_band_idx]:.2f} cm-1, intensity {y[g_band_idx]:.2f}")
print(f"Max intensity: {np.max(y):.2f}")
